main_text.p: abiisse, miseri damnata etiam post violentam neccem memoria docuit.
main_text.head: Offenso principe nutantibus vocem patronam nemo largitur.
main_text.p: Ut in triviis jacens bidental, ut fulminis afflatu quasi Jovis ira perculsos, omnes ne contractu contaminentur refugiunt: sic maiestatisMajestatis rei. causam dicentes qua proximi qua remoti repellunt. Libo interim veste mutata cum prioribus fœminis, circumire domos, orare affines, vocem adversum pericula poscere: abnuentibus cunctis, cum diversa prætenderent, eadem formidine.
main_text.head: Leges & Senatus consulta callidorum principum arbitrio torquentur.
main_text.p: Iniqua sanè, moribus tamen recepta, judicii forma Romam invaserat, ut servi, ad exsculpendam pro do-mino veritatem,Legum inversio. in quæstionem & tormenta dederen-tur. quæstio tamen in caput domini veteri senatus consulto prohibebatur. Negat Libo Drusus crimina objecta. servi ejus in tormenta poscuntur. Senatusconsultum huic atrocitati repugnat. Ut salvo jure interrogari possint, callidius & novi juris repertor Tiberius, mancipari singulos actori publico jubet. Quid est leges & jura specie juris perfringere, si hoc non est? Sic veteratoria juris interpretatione, quia triumvirali supplicio affici virginem inauditum habebatur, Sejani filiam à carnifice laqueum juxta comprimi voluit.
main_text.head: Captata clementiæ fama, cognitorum invidia sævitur.
main_text.p: Reus ab omni patronorum ope, à spe mitigandi per se principis depulsus, extremas preces per propinquos ad placandam principis offensi iram movit. responsum

page.notes: Right margin notes: "Majestatis rei." (beside the "Libo" paragraph, at the line "dicentes qua") and "Legum inversio." (two lines, beside "veritatem"), both placed where they stand. The long s has been written as plain s throughout. "maiestatis" is my reading of the printed form; the scan could also read "majestatis". "triviis" and "neccem" are as read. "responsum" at the end of the last line is italic and sits within the full text line, so I kept it in the text, not as a catchword. "Senatusconsultum" appears split across a line end with no visible hyphen, so it is written whole. "V.Annal." is a citation line below the paragraph, set as a paragraph. Faint show-through from the reverse side (top centre and right edge) was ignored.
